subject: Proposed compensation band adjustments & short-term redeployment plan
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Avery Talent <sarah@averytalent.com>
Cc: Mercer HR Consulting <mercer@consult.com>
Date: Tue, 12 Jan 2027 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Proposed compensation band adjustments & short-term redeployment plan

Team,

TL;DR: attached is a conservative compensation-band adjustment proposal and a 90-day redeployment plan that pauses 6 open requisitions and reassigns two floating headcount slots to priority product work. I need leadership sign-off (Vivek + Lauren) and a green light to notify Talent and our recruiting partner by EOD Friday so we can pause external candidate pipelines.

Context: after last week's exec review we need to reduce near-term spend while preserving delivery on the most time-sensitive roadmap items (model serving and infra reliability). This proposal aims to avoid permanent layoffs by pausing offers, limiting new offers to mission-critical roles, and redeploying near-term capacity.

Key points: 
- Pause: 6 open reqs across Platform and Growth (see sheet).
- Redeploy: 2 floating headcount (one senior SWE, one ML infra PM) to Model Serving SLO work for Q1.
- Comp bands: small upward adjustment for retention-critical ICs (2-4%), with a narrower upper band for external hires in non-critical roles. Proposal attached (comp-band-proposal.pdf).
- Timeline: recruiting pause communication to external partners planned for 2027-01-15; internal redeploy actions completed by 2027-01-31.

Request: please reply with APPROVE / APPROVE_WITH_CONDITIONS / DENY and any conditions. If APPROVE, I will coordinate formal notices to recruiting partners and update the hiring dashboard and hiring freeze registry.

Attachments: comp-band-proposal.pdf, headcount-rebalance.xlsx

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Head of Product Operations
Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Avery Talent <sarah@averytalent.com>, Mercer HR Consulting <mercer@consult.com>
Date: Tue, 12 Jan 2027 10:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Proposed compensation band adjustments & short-term redeployment plan

Kim — thanks for the clear proposal and attachments. Quick notes from my side: 

1) High-level I support a temporary pause of non-critical reqs if we can commit the redeployed headcount to measurable deliverables (two-week milestones, clear owners). I want to see the milestone list in Notion before I sign off.
2) Compensation bands: OK with modest retention increases for at-risk ICs but do NOT want to open a broad raise window — keep scope narrow and tied to validated risk (offers accepted elsewhere or critical retention conversations).
3) Timing: notifying recruiting partners on 1/15 is fine. Please coordinate with Finance on any comp commitments.

One ask: add a short paragraph in the email to Talent confirming that paused pipelines will be reactivated with 30-day notice once capacity changes. That reduces churn on the agency side.

APPROVE_WITH_CONDITIONS (see above).

— Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
VP, Engineering
Redwood Inference
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Avery Talent <sarah@averytalent.com>, Mercer HR Consulting <mercer@consult.com>
Date: Wed, 13 Jan 2027 08:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Proposed compensation band adjustments & short-term redeployment plan

On Tue, Jan 12, 2027 at 9:15 AM Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com> wrote:
> Team,
> 
> TL;DR: attached is a conservative compensation-band adjustment proposal and a 90-day redeployment plan that pauses 6 open requisitions and reassigns two floating headcount slots to priority product work. I need leadership sign-off (Vivek + Lauren) and a green light to notify Talent and our recruiting partner by EOD Friday so we can pause external candidate pipelines.

Thanks Kim — I read the spreadsheet and the band memo. My input: 
- Approve the pause on the 6 reqs as listed, but add an exception process: hiring manager can petition for a one-off exception with a 2-week business case and a cross-functional sign-off (Product Owner + Finance).
- Comp bands: support the retention adjustments but limit retroactive increases — those should be exceptional and require HR waiver from Mercer.
- Redeployment: agree with the two roles to redeploy. Please ensure managers of the paused reqs are informed and given visibility into the reallocation decisions.

Decision: APPROVE_WITH_CONDITIONS (exception process + Mercer waiver for retroactives).

Lauren Bishop
Director, People Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Avery Talent <sarah@averytalent.com>
Cc: Mercer HR Consulting <mercer@consult.com>
Date: Fri, 15 Jan 2027 16:45:00 -0800
Subject: Final: comp band adjustments & redeploy plan (approved with conditions)

Folks — thanks for the quick reviews and clear feedback. Summary of next steps (action items completed or assigned):

- Approval status: APPROVED_WITH_CONDITIONS (Vivek + Lauren). Conditions noted and captured in the attached tracker.
- Exception process: Kimberly to publish the one-off request template and routing list by Monday 2027-01-18 (will add Product Owner + Finance approvers).
- Mercer waiver: Lauren to escalate HR retroactive waiver request to Mercer; target response by 2027-01-22.
- Talent notification: Sarah (Avery Talent) — please pause external outreach for the 6 reqs listed in the spreadsheet; we'll notify you of any exceptions within 72 hours post-request. Please confirm receipt and implement pause by COB Monday.
- Finance/Payroll: Mercer — please hold off on retroactive comp changes until waiver confirmation.

I am copying the shared drive link where the live plan and milestone list will be kept: https://drive.google.com/drive/fakeDoc123. I will update the Notion runbook as decisions are finalized: https://redwoodnotion.company/hiring/redeploy-2027.

Attachments: headcount-rebalance.xlsx (updated with final decisions), comp-band-proposal.pdf (final v1).

Kim
Kimberly Park
